deploybot: Heads-up: rolling migration `user_profiles_partitioning_v1` scheduled to run at 23:30 UTC as part of release v2.20.0-db. Migration will create new partitioned table and stream rows with a parallel backfill. Expected per-shard window: brief DDL crate on parent (non-blocking), short swap lock ~10-20s, backfill estimated 45-90m depending on throttling. Rolling policy: 1-shard canary -> 10% -> full. Pins: api@2.20.0 ingestion@2.20.0.
Priya: size note — active users table ~3.5M rows/shard peak. Backfill will stream live writes; we'll set ratecap to avoid rep lag.
Alex: request: add deploy manifest pin for client-proto@3.5.1 to avoid field reorder issues. Also add feature flag `profiles_partitioned` default off.
Devon: rollback plan draft: 1) flip FF `profiles_partitioned` -> off (instant) 2) if backfill in progress, stop workers (graceful drain) 3) if switch already done, swap back to original table using rename+trigger fallback (requires brief lock) — estimate 20m for full rollback.
Mei: SRE ask: please schedule an automatic holdpoint 10m before the final swap so we can validate replication and tail error budget. Also add `--fallback=throttle` if run >75m.
Priya: agree. Preflight steps: 1) run canary on single shard in staging 2) validate consumer correctness (webhooks + search) 3) pin deploys 30m before start 4) create release note and CS ping.
Alex: command snippet I'll run from CI:
```
pg_migrate apply user_profiles_partitioning_v1 \
  --pin v2.20.0 \
  --ratecap 3 \
  --holdpoint 1800 \
  --fallback throttle \
  --notify #eng-oncall
```
Devon: monitoring: watch panels pg.replication.lag, app.error.rate.profile-writes, and skyline DB cpu. Add verbose logging for backfill workers.
oncall-bot: Notice: eu-central-1 replication lag spike earlier today. Ensure threshold alerts set to 2x baseline.
Priya: CS blurb: "Planned profile partition migration tonight 23:30 UTC. Minimal risk of short write pause (~<30s) during swap. Contact: @Priya" — posting 45m before.
Mei: I'll be on-call for the holdpoint and final swap. If anything anomalous, we revert flags then stop workers.
Alex: will run staging canary now and report 12m after results.
deploybot: Scheduled: user_profiles_partitioning_v1 will start at 23:30:00 UTC. Holdpoint at 00:00:00 UTC. Pins: api@2.20.0, ingestion@2.20.0, client-proto@3.5.1. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #customer-success.
Priya: acknowledged. Keeping channel short, will drop detailed logs in #eng-releases-runlogs. :white_check_mark:
